ModMetaData.name: VFE Mechanoids (HSK/CE Patched)
ModMetaData.author: Oskar Potocki, Kentington, Sarg Bjornson, erdelf, Kikohi, Chowder, Taranchuk, ISOREX — HSK/CE patch by CarbineAction
ModMetaData.description:
HSK/CE-patched version of Vanilla Factions Expanded - Mechanoids, tuned for the Hardcore SK modpack.
Original mod by Oskar Potocki, Kentington, Sarg Bjornson, erdelf, Kikohi, Chowder, Taranchuk, and ISOREX. This patch version rebalances player-facing content to fit HSK's spacer-tier economy and bundles the community-made CE compatibility patches.
--- HSK-NATIVE TUNING ---
MATERIALS — Steel → SteelBar 1:5 conversion across ~55 references (HSK's "Steel" defName is raw iron ore; SteelBar is refined steel for crafting).
TURRETS — 4 auto-turrets (AutoChargeBlaster, AutoChargeLance, AutoInfernoCannon, AutoMortar) get Mechanism ingredient gating. Stats + costs use HSK spacer-tier materials (Plasteel + ComponentSpacer + VFE_ComponentMechanoid).
LONG RANGE MISSILE LAUNCHER — kept at HSK-compliant spacer ingredients (already uses Plasteel + ComponentSpacer).
MECHANITE ARMOR — HSK-native recipe: 70 Cloth + SteelBar 10 + Plasteel 20 + ComponentSpacer 1 (UnderArmor), equivalent for pants.
WORKTOMAKE — 2x scaling on crafted buildings to match HSK's slower pace.
RESEARCH — VFE research gated behind HSK's Fabrication/AdvancedFabrication progression.
--- DISABLED PLAYER CONTENT ---
21 player-buildable buildings removed from architect menu where they overlap with HSK's existing mods. Enemy raids + quest content preserved (the ThingDefs still exist, just hidden from player build UI).
Electronics Fabrication (3): - Steel extractor (HSK has Electric Smelter) - Component assembler (HSK has Fabrication Bench) - Advanced assembler (HSK has spacer-tier Fabrication)
Masonry + Metallics (3): - Automatic drill (HSK has Deep Drill) - Masonry saw (HSK has Stonecutter's Table) - Plasteel forge (HSK has Plasteel recipe at Smithy)
Munitions + Armament (3): - Artillery foundry (HSK has shell crafting at TableMachining) - Chemfuel clarifier (HSK has Biofuel Refinery) - Mechanized weaponsmith (HSK has weapon benches)
Medicinal (3): - Drug powderizer, Medicine granulator, Neutroamine infuser (HSK has Drug Lab)
Provisions (2): - Conveyor oven (HSK has stoves), Meat grinder (HSK has butcher table)
Wearables (2): - Auto loom (HSK has Tailoring Bench), Synthread synthesizer (HSK has recipe)
Mech Stations (4): - Autocleaner, Autohauler, Autominer, Autobuilder (HSK has haplo.miscellaneous.robots.hsk)
Missile Launcher (1): - VFE_LongRangeMissileLauncher (HSK has its own artillery/rocket systems)
Production Infrastructure (3): - Factory Hopper, Versatile Assembler, Textile Recycler (HSK has its own stockpile/hopper system, fabrication benches, and tailoring)
Utility (3): - Autocrane, Liquid freezer, Construction lamp (HSK equivalents exist)
--- PRESERVED GAMEPLAY ---
- Mechanoid faction + enemy raids (full roster) - All combat mech charging stations (Combat, Pyro, Raider, Riot, Turret mobile, Strider) - Unique features: Autoharvester, Autosower, Textile recycler, Mechanite LF reinforcer, Blight auto repeller, AutoMedic, Autobroadcaster, Supercomputer (research automation), Indoctrination Pod - Factory system infrastructure: Factory hopper, Versatile assembler - Mechanite armor (under armor + pants) - VFE_ComponentMechanoid resource + research tree - Ship landing events, quest scripts, custom scenarios - KCSG enemy base generation (broadcasting stations, factories, structures)
--- BUNDLED CE PATCHES ---
Community-made HSK CE patches (originally at G:\HSK CE patches\Vanilla Factions Expanded - Mechanoids\) bundled and gated by IfModActive="CETeam.CombatExtended" in loadFolders.xml. Covers: - 3 new CE bullet defs (VFE_Bullet_5x35mmHyper, ChargeRailgun_CE, TeslaProjectileCE) - Turret CE stats (Building_TurretGunCE conversion) - Mech weapons CE ballistics (advanced mechanoid guns) - Mech race CE stats (armor, health, attack for Advanced + Ancient mechs) - Mechanite apparel CE stats (Bulk, WornBulk, armor ratings) - Pawnkind CE loadouts (mech pawnkinds) - Scenario CE compatibility - CombinationDef CE patches for factory-produced ammo/weapons
--- COMPATIBILITY ---
Requires: HSK (skyarkhangel.hsk), Combat Extended (CETeam.CombatExtended), Harmony, VE Framework. NOT compatible with original "OskarPotocki.VFE.Mechanoid" — enable this INSTEAD.
